meta.title: Kenya: Central Bank of Kenya statistics (exchange rates, interest rates, public debt, government finance, money, GDP, inflation, remittances, reserves)
meta.rule: Values as published by CBK on the retrieval date, each series with its file URL, SHA-256, column and coverage. Blank cells stay null and are listed in gaps.

publisher: Central Bank of Kenya (www.centralbank.go.ke), retrieved directly; site reachable through proxy (HTTP 200)

kes_usd_monthly_average.name: Kenya shilling per US dollar, monthly average
kes_usd_monthly_average.definition: CBK table "Kenya Shilling Monthly Average Exchange Rates", column "United States dollar"

kes_usd_end_period.name: Kenya shilling per US dollar, end of month
kes_usd_end_period.definition: CBK table "Kenya Shilling End Period Exchange Rates", column "United States dollar"

central_bank_rate.name: Central Bank Rate (CBR)
central_bank_rate.definition: CBK table "CENTRAL BANK RATES", column "Central Bank Rate" (monthly value as published; CBK does not state in the CSV whether it is a month average or month-end)

public_debt_domestic.name: Public debt, domestic
public_debt_domestic.definition: CBK table "PUBLIC DEBT (shillings million)", column "Domestic Debt"

public_debt_external.name: Public debt, external
public_debt_external.definition: CBK table "PUBLIC DEBT (shillings million)", column "External Debt"

gov_total_tax_revenue.name: Total tax revenue
gov_total_tax_revenue.frequency: monthly cumulative within fiscal year (July-June); fiscal_year = June value
gov_total_tax_revenue.definition: CBK table "COMPOSITION OF GOVERNMENT REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE (shillings million)", CSV column 8; values accumulate from July, so the June row is the fiscal-year total

gov_total_revenue.name: Total revenue (tax + non-tax)
gov_total_revenue.frequency: monthly cumulative within fiscal year (July-June); fiscal_year = June value
gov_total_revenue.definition: CBK table "COMPOSITION OF GOVERNMENT REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE (shillings million)", CSV column 10; values accumulate from July, so the June row is the fiscal-year total

gov_domestic_interest.name: Recurrent expenditure: domestic interest
gov_domestic_interest.frequency: monthly cumulative within fiscal year (July-June); fiscal_year = June value
gov_domestic_interest.definition: CBK table "COMPOSITION OF GOVERNMENT REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE (shillings million)", CSV column 14; values accumulate from July, so the June row is the fiscal-year total

gov_foreign_interest.name: Recurrent expenditure: foreign interest

gov_total_recurrent_expenditure.name: Total recurrent expenditure

money_supply_m3.name: Broad money M3 (M2 plus residents' foreign currency deposits)
money_supply_m3.definition: CBK 'IMF Programme Banking Survey - at current exchange rate', row "M2 plus Residents' Foreign Curr. Deposits (M3)"; last columns flagged 'Prov' (provisional)

gdp_nominal.name: GDP at current prices
gdp_nominal.definition: CBK "Annual GDP" CSV, column nominal_gdp_prices; CBK republishes KNBS national accounts (constant-price base year not stated in CSV; Statistical Bulletin June 2026 uses 2016 prices)

gdp_real_growth.name: Real GDP growth
gdp_real_growth.definition: CBK "Annual GDP" CSV, column real_gdp_growth; CBK republishes KNBS national accounts (constant-price base year not stated in CSV; Statistical Bulletin June 2026 uses 2016 prices)

gdp_real.name: GDP at constant prices
gdp_real.definition: CBK "Annual GDP" CSV, column real_gdp_prices; CBK republishes KNBS national accounts (constant-price base year not stated in CSV; Statistical Bulletin June 2026 uses 2016 prices)

inflation_12_month.name: 12-month (year-on-year) CPI inflation
inflation_12_month.definition: CBK "Inflation Rates" page, column "12-Month Inflation"; underlying CPI compiled by KNBS (Statistical Bulletin June 2026 CPI base Feb 2019 = 100)

source.note: HTML table (wpDataTable) on the page; no downloadable file offered

inflation_annual_average.name: Annual average CPI inflation
inflation_annual_average.definition: CBK "Inflation Rates" page, column "Annual Average Inflation"; underlying CPI compiled by KNBS (Statistical Bulletin June 2026 CPI base Feb 2019 = 100)

source.note: HTML table (wpDataTable) on the page; no downloadable file offered

checks.check: public debt domestic + external = total (tolerance KSh 1m)
M3 month sequence after year forward-fill is contiguous

not_staged: FX reserves monthly/annual history 2010-2015 (only weekly bulletin PDFs; pre-2016 December bulletins not listed on the page) -> see WDI FI.RES.TOTL.MO for an annual World Bank equivalent
Public debt service (principal repayments) not in CBK CSVs; only interest payments (revenue & expenditure table) staged
364-day T-bill: blank in CSV for some 2010-2011 months (no value published); 182-day blank Apr 2017
doubtful: Annual GDP CSV mixes base years: real GDP (constant prices) exceeds nominal GDP for 2010-2015, consistent with a 2016 price base but the CSV does not state the base; use growth rates, not levels, for real GDP
Reserves definition changes: usable reserves (excl. encumbered) to 2024; 2025-2026 bulletins drop the word usable
